_notes: mobile:login.networkError — the Korean still carries the Android-emulator / LAN-IP hint; the English keeps only the customer meaning (can't reach Hangyul at {{url}}, check connection, retry) because the emulator hint is dev-only now. Owner may want the Korean trimmed to match.

mobile:v3.docAction.LEGALIZE and mobile:v3.university.documentsCount — Korean says '아포스티유 또는 공증' (notarization), but the LEGALIZE action/count is the legalization path (apostille or, outside the Hague Convention, consular legalization). Rendered as 'apostille or consular legalization' per the glossary; notarization is a separate step.
mobile:plan.allowance.essay_review_rounds — Korean says only '자기소개서 첨삭'; the catalogue allowance covers personal statement AND study plan, so the English names both (matches student:v15 key).

Student-facing '상담사/컨설턴트' (counselor) rendered as 'the Hangyul Univ team' / 'the Hangyul team' per V22 team identity (STATE_MAP tone rule). Agency- and University-app strings keep 'counselor' because they are staff-facing.
mobile:v29.plan.supportDays has no plural family; '{{count}}-day' reads correctly for both 1 and 3, so no _one/_other split is needed.

mobile:plan.chooseLede — Korean '유학 준비 전 과정을 함께해요' would overpromise for Basic (no managed applications); English says the plan stays with you, without claiming it covers everything. Owner to confirm.
mobile:more.noPlanHint — Korean source has a typo '한결' for '한귤'; English unchanged.
student:v17.gate.what.help — '컨시어지 지원' (concierge) is not a catalogue service; rendered as help from the Hangyul team. Owner to confirm the intended entitlement.

V31 debt (a): the overdue-writing title is common:task.writingOverdue / common:notify.writingOverdue, which are not in this job (nor in en-consoles). Not patched here; suggested wording is in the reply.
